title: Growth Class
statement: Implement `solve(t1, t4)`. Same rule as the profiling classifier: return `linear` when `t4` is at most 6 times `t1`, and `super` otherwise. Times are positive integers.
constraints: super means the curve is steeper than linear noise

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: n versus 4n is the cheap experiment after you change an algorithm.

editorial: n versus 4n is the cheap experiment after you change an algorithm. Linear work scales near 4. Quadratic work scales near 16. The factor 6 is the fence between noise and a real exponent change.
